title: Each account still has its built-in Counter Sale customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Customers.
  2. Open the built-in Counter Sale customer's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the built-in Counter Sale customer.

Step 2:

  • Its page opens as today, with its card and tabs.
